product.olivetti-snx-160e.summary: The SNX 160’s replacement retained the dual-processor option.
product.olivetti-snx-160e.history: Olivetti’s guide dates the replacement of the SNX 160 by the SNX 160E to April 1995.
product.olivetti-snx-160e.architecture: The processor card lets the system expand. The GO2063 and GO2079-100 have a documented second socket for a 100 MHz Pentium.
product.olivetti-snx-160e.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160e.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160e.service-guide-: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 1
